name: skills
description: Portable skills for engineering refactors, security and supply-chain hardening, tests and CI, accessible UI systems, platform and data migrations, documentation, releases, personal interviews, and clear communication.

interface.longDescription: Review code with evidence, audit database schemas and queries, audit code and repository security, assess SOC 2 readiness with reports in chat, remove unnecessary complexity, refactor with current official docs and regression tests, upgrade dependencies with migrations and verification, and communicate clearly at the requested level of detail. Set up signed public GitHub releases with automatic updates and separate development apps, or private releases with licensed updates and device administration. Fix Vercel production and www redirects, reconcile DNS, and verify websites. Report worktrees, Docker resources, extra test databases, and agent-created artifacts directly in chat, reclaim only confirmed items while highlighting protected resources, save Omarchy window layouts, and manage AI tools and JavaScript runtimes with OS-aware setup, confirmation for missing installs, verified updates, and a complete status report. Consolidate auth, state, SDKs, routing, errors, and workspaces; harden tests, TypeScript, npm supply chains, and CI; standardize design systems and component libraries; verify accessibility, performance, localization, and platform parity; generate documentation and architecture maps; and conduct personal interviews with authorized memory persistence.
defaultPrompt: Review these changes with the code-review skill.
Assess this project with the soc2-readiness skill and report findings in chat.
Implement this with the code-build skill.
Refactor this code with current official docs and regression tests using the code-refactor skill.
Audit this repository and its GitHub Actions with the code-security skill.
Review schemas, queries, and migrations with the database-audit skill.
Update dependencies and apply required migrations with the upgrade-dependencies skill.
Explain this with the make-sense skill.
Write explanations, instructions, and reports with the simplify skill.
Set up private desktop distribution with the private-desktop-release skill.
Set up and publish this app with the public-desktop-release skill.
Fix production redirects and DNS warnings with the vercel-domain-cleanup skill.
Report dev-space cleanup candidates and protected resources in chat with reclaim-dev-space, then wait for my confirmation.
Save my Omarchy window layout with the save-omarchy-window-layout skill.
Set up missing AI tools with confirmation and update existing tools with the ai-harness-setup skill.

Use $ci-cd-triage. Diagnose this failing pipeline, fix the root cause, and distinguish local verification from hosted results.
Use $accessibility-audit. Audit and fix accessibility barriers in the main user journeys; report manual and automated coverage separately.
Use $documentation-generation. Generate accurate project documentation from the code and verify safe setup commands, examples, and links.
Use $interview. Interview me in depth about relevant parts of my life you do not know yet, and save useful answers through the supported memory system.
Use $code-refactor to consolidate auth, state, SDKs, routing, and errors with regression protection.
Use $code-build to standardize components and design tokens or wire localization.
Use $code-security to remediate confirmed vulnerabilities and harden dependency installation.
